clauses: This distinguished astrophysicist and researcher made profound contributions to the field of astronomy.
Recognized for their exceptional work, they were elected a Fellow of the Royal Society and honored as a Knight Bachelor.

Their impressive list of accolades includes the Royal Medal, the Bruce Medal, and the Gold Medal of the Royal Astronomical Society, as well as delivering the Guthrie Lecture and receiving the Royal Society Bakerian Medal.
Despite their massive influence on modern astrophysics, this scientist was never awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics.
